## In short

Once a month, this blog takes one idea from cardiac mapping and explains it properly. The first posts arrive in the
coming weeks.

## What to expect

Posts come in four kinds:

- **Concept:** one idea explained in depth, with a live figure where it helps.
- **Paper:** a plain-language walk through one open-access paper, recreating a figure with our own code.
- **Behind the module:** how a new module was built, what was hard, and what we got wrong.
- **Reader questions:** answers to good questions sent with the **Feedback** button.

Posts follow the same rules as the course: sources for every claim, no clinical advice, and nothing here is for
diagnosis or treatment. Like the rest of the site, they are developed with AI assistants and checked against the
course's written rules (see [how the content is written and checked](../../../about.qmd#how-the-content-is-written-and-checked)).

## Follow along

Subscribe with the [RSS feed](../../index.xml), or suggest a topic with the **Feedback** button at the bottom right of
this page.
